Inspect the actual changed artifacts. Report only blocking or material findings.

Evaluate learning flow, pacing, cognitive load, live-demo reliability, sandbox truthfulness, future enterprise portability, GitHub product accuracy, workflow security, accessibility, exact commands, recovery paths, and whether the one-hour experience delivers a coherent end-to-end agentic engineering story rather than a feature tour.
